name: Kavaratti
prompt: Cinematic slow aerial circling Kavaratti lagoon — camera arcs from the white-coral Ujra Mosque on the leeward beach, glides over the marine aquarium jetty into the shallow turquoise lagoon, traditional odam fishing boats moored along the reef edge, coconut palms rimming the long narrow island, mid-morning equatorial sun, no crowds, 8 seconds

name: Agatti Island
prompt: Cinematic POV from a cockpit on final approach to Agatti — the 1.2km coral airstrip splits the narrow island lengthwise, calm turquoise lagoon on the left wing and deeper Arabian Sea on the right, sand spit curving off the runway end, coconut palms flashing past on touchdown, late-afternoon golden light, 8 seconds

name: Bangaram Island
prompt: Cinematic aerial descending over Bangaram — an uninhabited teardrop atoll ringed by white sand and a perfectly clear turquoise lagoon, the satellite islets of Tinnakara and Parali floating to the north, a single thatched-roof resort cluster tucked among coconut palms, no boats on the water, midday tropical sun, 8 seconds

name: Minicoy Island
prompt: Cinematic drone spiraling up the white Minicoy lighthouse at the southern tip — camera rises past the wrought-iron balcony to reveal the 10km crescent island below, Maldivian-influenced thatched bawa village houses, the deep Eight Degree Channel beyond the reef, golden hour shadow stretching across the lagoon, 8 seconds

name: Kadmat Island
prompt: Cinematic underwater push along Kadmat's house reef — sun-dappled hard coral garden, parrotfish and butterflyfish schools parting around the lens, a free-diver gliding overhead, then surface break revealing the 8km-long narrow island and a kayaker on the turquoise lagoon, 8 seconds

name: Little Andaman
prompt: Cinematic slow-motion of a longboard surfer dropping into the Butler Bay right-hand point on Little Andaman — empty palm-fringed beach behind, dense Onge tribal forest line in the distance, quick cut to nearby White Surf Falls cascading through tropical evergreen, golden afternoon light, 8 seconds

name: Chidiya Tapu
prompt: Cinematic timelapse from Munda Pahar viewpoint at Chidiya Tapu, southern tip of South Andaman — sun dropping into the Bay of Bengal, sky shifting orange to violet, silhouetted mangrove tidal flats reflecting the colour change, white-bellied sea eagles tracing the shoreline, exposed coral on the low-tide flats, 8 seconds

name: Barren Island
prompt: Cinematic boat approach across the Andaman Sea to Barren Island, South Asia's only confirmed active volcano — symmetric 354m cone rising straight from deep blue water, a steady plume of ash steaming from the crater, black lava flow scarring the western flank, no vegetation, no landing, extreme isolation, 8 seconds

name: Puducherry
prompt: Cinematic slow walk down Rue Romain Rolland in Puducherry's French Quarter — mustard-yellow and grey colonial bungalows with louvered shutters, bougainvillea spilling over compound walls, a vintage Bullet motorcycle leaning against the kerb, Notre Dame des Anges twin towers framed at the end of the street, soft early-morning light on the cobblestones, 8 seconds

name: Auroville
prompt: Cinematic reveal of the Matrimandir golden sphere at Auroville — camera pushes along the red-earth garden path past the tall banyan, lily ponds and the twelve symbolic petals ringing the dome, dawn sunlight catching the gilded geodesic discs of the exterior, no people, the silence of meditation hour, 8 seconds

name: Karaikal
prompt: Cinematic dawn on Karaikal Beach in the Cauvery delta — long narrow shoreline of grey sand, painted catamaran fishing boats being pushed off through small surf, the Tirunalla Vararuna temple gopuram catching the first orange light a kilometre inland, low river mist drifting over coconut groves, 8 seconds

name: Silvassa
prompt: Cinematic aerial over Dudhni Lake near Silvassa — calm reservoir on the Daman Ganga River, Sahyadri foothills folding into mist on the Maharashtra side, a lone speedboat trailing a wake across the mirror water, dense moist-deciduous forest carpeting the shore, golden hour low side-light, 8 seconds

name: Kaza
prompt: Cinematic slow aerial push over Kaza town in Spiti Valley at 3,800m — camera drifts up the Spiti River past stacked-pyramid whitewashed houses, barley fields turning gold, the Sakya Tangyud (Kaza Gompa) on the hillside, prayer flags strung between rooftops, ochre Himalayan rain-shadow walls framing the valley, afternoon clear-sky light, 8 seconds

name: Chandratal Lake
prompt: Cinematic reveal of Chandratal crescent moon lake at 4,300m, source of the Chandra River near Kunzum Pass — camera rises over the moraine ridge to unveil the glacial-flour turquoise crescent below, scree slopes streaked with snow, cloud shadows sweeping the brown barren amphitheatre, parachute tents at the meadow shore for scale, 8 seconds

name: Har Ki Doon
prompt: Cinematic drone tracking over Har Ki Doon meadow at 3,566m toward the twin Swargarohini peaks — Pandava-ascension trail winding through the wildflower carpet in late August, Tons River cutting the valley floor, birch and rhododendron forest boundary, a lone trekker for scale, the wood-and-stone Osla village smoke rising in the distance, golden side-light, 8 seconds

name: Hemkund Sahib
prompt: Cinematic pan around Hemkund Sahib glacial lake at 4,329m — golden five-pointed gurdwara dome in the foreground, the seven-peak Saptashring amphitheatre cradling the basin, lake mirror still in early morning, Sikh pilgrims in turbans walking the parikrama path barefoot, late-summer Brahma Kamal flowers along the rocks, cold thin-air light, 8 seconds

name: Khardung La
prompt: Cinematic slow approach to the Khardung La pass marker at 5,359m on the Leh-Diskit road — strings of prayer flags snapping in strong wind, the painted altitude signpost in focus, sastrugi ice patterns on the verge, an Enfield motorcyclist riding into frame, the brown switchbacks descending into Nubra Valley below, oxygen-thin midday light, 8 seconds

name: Turtuk
prompt: Cinematic aerial over Turtuk — India's last Balti village before the LoC, ~4km from Pakistan — camera glides over April apricot blossoms, two-storey carved-wood Balti houses, the Yabgo Palace ruin on a low ridge, smoke rising from a chulli oil press, the Shyok River below and snow-clad Karakoram peaks on the horizon, warm evening light, 8 seconds

name: Dambuk
prompt: Cinematic aerial over Dambuk's orange orchards at the December Orange Festival peak — camera drifts over citrus-laden trees, Idu Mishmi performers in red-and-black striped shawls dancing near the riverside main stage, Dibang River braids glinting below, truck-rafts crossing where the seasonal bridge ends, Mishmi Hills wall framing the valley, mid-morning harvest light, 8 seconds

name: Aalo
prompt: Cinematic dawn aerial over Aalo town at the Yamne–Siang river confluence — camera tracks along the ~100m Patum Heritage Bamboo Bridge swaying over the green water, Galo tribal stilt houses waking with cooking smoke, the Donyi-Polo prayer house roof catching first light, valley mist rising through evergreen slopes of West Siang, 8 seconds

name: Candolim
prompt: Cinematic slow aerial pull-back from Fort Aguada's whitewashed lighthouse on the Sinquerim cliff — revealing the 1612 Portuguese laterite fort walls and rusted gun mounts, Aguada Bay below, the 4km Candolim Beach arc curving north toward Calangute, the rusted River Princess shipwreck silhouette in the surf, calm turquoise Arabian Sea at early-morning low tide before tourists arrive, palm-lined resort spine in soft pre-rush light, smooth dolly, 8 seconds

name: Assagao
prompt: Cinematic slow tracking shot through an Assagao village lane — inland from Vagator and Anjuna — camera glides past restored Portuguese-era bungalows in lemon-yellow and ochre with shell-window shutters, bougainvillea spilling over laterite walls, the white Igreja de São Caetano spire rising at the lane's end, an old laterite well in a courtyard, paddy-field horizon, heritage cafe lanterns glowing, scooter passing in soft focus, warm late-afternoon light, 8 seconds

name: Siolim
prompt: Cinematic slow aerial gliding over the Chapora River estuary at sunset — camera tracks across the 800m Siolim-Chopdem bridge linking Bardez to Pernem, the century-old St. Anthony's Church twin white steeples rising over Siolim village square in middle distance, a returning fishing trawler trailing gulls on the river, paddy fields and coconut palms layered on both banks, warm golden light reflecting off the water, 8 seconds
